resources.string: Revo draws a ring of soft dots around the edge of your screen that drift with the motion of the vehicle you\'re in. Your eyes get a moving cue that agrees with what your inner ear feels, which is what actually causes motion sickness in the first place - keep it running low in your peripheral vision while you read or scroll.
Revo needs permission to draw over other apps - that\'s the whole feature, since the dots have to sit on top of whatever you\'re using.
Tap to open Revo and turn it off
